tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest a coupled mechanism, but the pilot varies only one input. The open-branch probe can distinguish candidate transfer laws before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary bridge model to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations vary only u_now, leaving the coupled transfer mechanism and its dependence on other inputs unidentified.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly addresses the missing mechanism discrimination.
It is not relevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
